listitem.para:
This is entry point of the application. For debugging, (that is not in production), application can be executed to control specific features, which could be true/false. True allows execution, false prevents execution of feature. They are:
Read Errors from device if available
Clear errors on successful read
Read Usage Statistics from device if available
Clear Usage statistics from device if successfully read from device
This main function also setups the logging framework, and starts the application.
